description: Black to kill. White has the shape of an L with one extra eye-stone. Find the throw-in that destroys both potential eyes, then follow up to capture.

S1.comment: Vital point. The throw-in attacks both potential eyes (L1 and J1) at once.

P1.comment: Remove white's last outside liberty. White is forced to capture, but the resulting shape has only one eye.

S1.comment: Throw in again. White has only one eye and no outside liberties - the whole group is captured.

T1.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with K1 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at L1 and J1.

R1.comment: Wrong direction. White captures with K1 and the resulting shape has clean eyes at L1 and J1.

P1.comment: Outside before inside fails - white plays the vital point K1 and lives with two clean eyes.
